data.explanation: The tax office (Finanzamt) calculated your 2025 income tax and found that too much wage tax was withheld, so you are owed a refund of €428.00, which will be paid to your account on file. No action is needed to receive it. If you disagree with the calculation, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the Finanzamt, or declare it there for the record; the app shows until when you can still do this. If you do nothing by the deadline shown, the assessment becomes final.

items.title: Receive income tax refund for 2025
items.action: No action needed; the refund will be transferred automatically

date.text: Sie erhalten 428,00 € zurück. Wir überweisen den Betrag auf Ihr Konto DE72 2605 0001 0044 1029 38.

items.quote: Mit dem Einspruch können Sie diesen Bescheid anfechten, und zwar binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe.
